causalAutopsy.notes: Not a defect in any one PR: an accumulating shape problem. The awareness-marker convention means every such PR appends a symbol to one import line, so collisions were structural and grew with the symbol count (26 by now). Surfaced by resolving the same conflict five times in a single session on #2201/#2261 and their re-merges, and by the operator seeing conflicts on consecutive PRs. Fixed by changing the shape rather than continuing to resolve by hand.
